description: Get audience demographics. The latest stored breakdown of your followers: gender and age as percentages, top countries and cities with counts, and followers online by hour when Instagram supplies it. 404 until the first refresh. Instagram withholds all of it for accounts under roughly 100 followers, which comes back as zeros rather than an error. Includes followers online by hour, which is what "when should I post" is answered from.
name: get_audience_demographics
